status: DRAFT v1 by akiendell_cc_0, 2026-11-14, for casting (orchestrator ask A). PARENT: the judge. Its child (the lane in transitions.py) is a-buildme-lane-asks-the-component-boundary-judge.
title: a ticket whose decisions write outside its owning component is refused at BUILDME (RULE 1 as physics for the write side)
intention: build_inspector publishes the judge buildme_stays_in_its_component(ticket), which names every path in the ticket's decisions' writes_to and bounds.in that belongs to a different component than the ticket's owning_intention, and each path that belongs to none.
why: Measured 2026-11-14: d3248 and 2517, owned by cairn/tools/base, edited cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py and nothing caught it, because encapsulation_holds (outline 17.13.1) is a path check over IMPORTS only, and RULE 1 says a ticket's build lives inside its own component. The write side has no physics. Census over CairnCommons/tickets against origin/main (391 tickets with an owner and writes): 89 cross a component line and 38 of the 177 open ones do, so this lane will red a real share of the queue and each of those is a ticket to split (children per component), not an exemption (Law 9). Outline: 9.4.2.3.7.1 (RULE 1 bounds a change to its component), 17.13.1.
traces_to: RULE 1, Law 4 (a rule that matters is enforced by physics), Law 6 (one owner).
how: D1: a component is the deepest ancestor directory of a path that holds an intention+why.json, lifted to its enclosing device when that charter sits under cairn/devices/<d>/tools or /machines (inside one device there is one owner, as 17.13.1 says); a component's proofs/ and validations/ are the component's own. D2: the judge reads the ticket the way its neighbours do (rehearsal.ticket_file), computes the owner region from owning_intention and a region per write, and returns one finding per foreign region naming the paths, an unresolvable owning_intention being refused, not skipped. D3: a path that belongs to no component (no charter ancestor: commons, .gitattributes, press_office) is its own finding class 'unowned'. D4: registered beside buildme_rides_the_outline_check. The charter line list is read from git ls-files of the checkout, so it does not read a component's code (RULE 1).

clauses.claim: a ticket owned by cairn/tools/base whose decisions write cairn/machines/build_inspector/inspector.py (the d3248/2517 shape) gets one finding naming that region and path
a ticket whose writes are its own component's code and proofs/, or a device's own tools/machines, gets none
a ticket with a write under no component gets an 'unowned' finding, and an owning_intention that does not resolve is refused loudly, never skipped
over the real corpus the judge's count of crossing tickets equals the census (89 of 391 at the measurement date, within tickets cast since)

decisions.text: D1: the judge and its region rule in the inspector, beside the other buildme_* judges.
D2: the proof, one tooth per clause, over a scratch commons and a scratch tree with charters.

out: cairn/tools/base (the lane that asks the judge is the child ticket)
